notes.title: v0.1.1.4 - Various improvements & fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Runner: Ignored out-of-bounds blocks and added 'level validity check' to block play if some missing blocks make the level non-playable.
[*] Editor:
[list]
[*] Added out-of-bounds overlays to show creators the blocks 'ignore zones'.
[*] Initialised the amounts to half (e.g. the 'grayscale' filter starts at 50% grayscale instead of 0%).
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] All game modes: Disabled gate collider after passing it to avoid re-trigger.
[*] Explore:
[list]
[*] Hid the overlay panel when using infinite time mode.
[*] Blocked 'replay' action when finishing game.
[*] Fixed diagonal bullets + reinitialised shooting properly.
[*] Made minimap handle taller to make it easier to grab.
[/list]
[*] Editor:
[list]
[*] Stored copied blocks in clipboard to allow for further re-pasting.
[*] Fixed music debugging context switches and positioning.
[/list]
[*] Inputs: Updated + Enforced 'replay' button on gamepads to make it different from 'color-2' and avoid overlap in Explore mode.
[*] Misc: Changed project settings to keep window aspect ratio even when resizing.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.1.1.3 - Editor improvements & Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Runner: Added the current number of attempts in finish panel for game over.
[*] Editor: Added shape/color shortcuts for the 'gate' and 'teleporter-in' blocks during placement.
[*] Steam achievements: Merged 'Shape Specialist' and 'Color Expert' achievements into just one multi-tier series of achievements where you need to match gates!
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Editor/Runner: Handled lane switching to a non-existent lane by ignoring trigger.
[*] Editor: Disabled the block rotation feature for the 'teleporter-out' blocks + Fixed minimap update when deleting a linked block + Fixed the 'Grand Architect' achievement stat progress update when pasting/duplicating blocks.
[*] Runner: Fixed the 'Persistent Player' achievement condition check.
[/list]

Steam achievements: Merged 'Shape Specialist' and 'Color Expert' achievements into just one multi-tier series of achievements where you need to match gates!

notes.title: v0.1.1.2 - Various improvements & fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Editor: Improve consistency of setting panels + reverse direction of the patterns zoom slider + add some shortcuts for common actions.
[*] Blocks: Add shortcuts to quickly change the shape of "gate-keys" and "lane-switches" while placing them.
[*] Menus: Refactor the control settings panel to add the new editor shortcuts and better organise the shortcuts.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Game: Only update Steam win statistics if NOT currently testing the level!
[*] Explore: Fix music reset when replaying with infinite time.
[*] Editor: While playtesting, enforce music reset if none was picked to avoid the victory music restarting on replay.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.1.0.2 - Many improvements & fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Local data: Make a subfolder per Steam user ID to allow for multiple players on the same computer.
[*] Puzzle: Add replay input.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Explore: Limit maximum number of enemies.
[*] Puzzle: Make controls display smaller + improve path recomputation.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Runner: Delay finish UI focus slightly to avoid endless cinematic edge-case.
[*] Chill: Enforce minimum 2 shapes/2 colors.
[*] Puzzle: Improve collision checks + gates reset (especially with fast animation speed!).
[*] Explore: Block player after finishing the game to avoid last-minute hits.
[/list]

tags.feature: Local data: Make a subfolder per Steam user ID to allow for multiple players on the same computer.

tags.balance_change: Explore: Limit maximum number of enemies.
Puzzle: Make controls display smaller + improve path recomputation.
